text_block_list.text:
The race is over. Мэдзиро Райан and Ines
Fujin are
met with unsparing applause
from the audience
who just witnessed
their fierce battle.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Having regained her confidence from the
heated
race, Мэдзиро Райан is more
motivated than ever for
the Kikuka Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро МакКуин, also having watched
the race,
ponders her upcoming matchup
against the
improved capability of
Мэдзиро Райан.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
We're midway through the Classics, and
more
tough races lie ahead for Ryan in
the fall.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
